label: nyiso 7 zonal gas
definition: U4: measured per-zone gas-hub basis (NYISO SOM Figure A-6 — Upstate on Tenn Z4 200L, east on Iroquois Z2, NYC on Transco Z6 NY), shifting each gas unit vs the east reference. Plus main's year-varying Central-East TTC (2350 pre-AC-Transmission 2023 / 3850 post 2024-25). Pulls the over-priced upstate level down toward actual (2025 Upstate 75->65 vs 55.5 RT); the west-east spread is still governed by interface binding (2023 +18 overshoot, 2024-25 ~+1 undershoot vs +4-8 actual) and awaits the seasonal-TTC (U7) refinement.
